exposure: COVID-19 pandemic time periods (before, during, after)
cohort: The study included all deliveries recorded from the Obstetrics Department of Attikon University Hospital in Greece over a 10-year period from 2015 to 2024.
finding: During and after the COVID-19 pandemic, the proportion of teenage pregnancies increased significantly, even as total births decreased.
mod_finding: The rate of cesarean sections among adolescent births increased to 63.1% in 2024, up from 37% before the pandemic.
